==Overview==
'''Section E''' is the 5th section the player will encounter within the game, being one that requires the strange keycard to enter, this section is supposed to be for experienced players, since its more difficult than the previous sections, overall there's 9 main threats in this section (11 if counting the i variants).

==Trivia==
* [https://youtu.be/erBdtnQqEvk?si=XMLlffRJVsnogK7m Update Executive Teaser 1]
* '''Section E''' is the first section to not have a entity that disables [[Claustrophobia]]
* [[Section Executive Invasion Event|The Executive Invasion]]
* E Section is the only section without a unique ambience (subject to change)

== Lore ==
* [[Section E]] is the section used to house the S.P.A.W.N after Sections [[Section A|A]] and [[Section D|D]] were abandoned, in order to power this section.
